g.text: F3 | unit = site-day instance (offline, future information available); 8 held-out instances, k enumerated
0..physical bound, 1-minute uniform-power grid max-flow, model offline_uniform_power_minute_grid.
confirmed_minimal is a statement inside the declared offline model, never a physical lower bound; the 22 kW run
produced the same class counts as the 7 kW run. Budget cap = 8.
